description: Historical v1.9.0 baseline template. The TX-1..TX-8 case mappings have been reconciled with current workloads, but historical measurements and metadata are not current performance evidence; consult benchmarks/benchmark_target_mapping.json and src/transaction/PERFORMANCE_EXPECTATIONS.md.

TX-1.label: OCC Commit P50
TX-1.note: Current case exports nearest-rank p50_real_time for successful commitTransaction samples; historical template has no current measurement.

TX-2.label: OCC Commit P99
TX-2.note: Current case exports nearest-rank p99_real_time for successful commitTransaction samples; historical template has no current measurement.

TX-3.label: Write-only transaction throughput (single thread)
TX-3.note: Historical v1.3.4 measurement is not current evidence. The former BM_TransactionContention was not a contention workload and is not a fallback.

TX-4.label: 2PC Latenz (5 Shards)
TX-4.note: Uses five in-process participants with unique coordinator and participant WALs plus per-shard fencing tokens; storage-application callbacks remain no-ops. A single-node mixed transaction is not a comparable fallback.

TX-6.label: Deadlock Predictor Call Latency
TX-6.note: Direct call-latency target; no baseline-relative percentage is claimed.

TX-8.label: Low-Contention Success Rate
TX-8.note: Uncontended single-thread unique-key insert; success_rate_percent counter required. This is not a contended workload.
